STEP 1 - Scene: A takeout-style lunch box with stir-fried greens, two kinds of cooked meat or fish, and corn on the cob.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white foam takeout container, roughly side-plate sized. Diameter taken as 20 cm, so area is about 314 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Stir-fried leafy greens (bok choy or gai lan) with a little oil
- Sliced white meat or fish with a light sauce
- Roasted or fried meat piece (pork or chicken)
- Two pieces of corn on the cob
- Small yellow egg or tofu piece

STEP 4 - Area (about 65% of the vessel is covered):
- Greens 25% (about 79 cm²)
- Sliced white meat 15% (about 47 cm²)
- Roasted meat 10% (about 31 cm²)
- Corn 12% (about 38 cm²)
- Egg/tofu 3% (about 9 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Greens: 79 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 196 ml
- Sliced meat: 47 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 71 ml
- Roasted meat: 31 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 47 ml
- Corn: 38 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 94 ml
- Egg/tofu: 9 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 9 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Greens: 196 × 0.15 ≈ 29 g
- Sliced meat: 71 × 0.95 ≈ 67 g
- Roasted meat: 47 × 0.95 ≈ 45 g
- Corn: 94 × 0.6 ≈ 56 g
- Egg/tofu: 9 × 0.9 ≈ 8 g
- Total ≈ 205 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens: 29 g × 30 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal
- Sliced meat: 67 g × 170 kcal/100 g ≈ 114 kcal
- Roasted meat: 45 g × 220 kcal/100 g ≈ 99 kcal
- Corn: 56 g × 96 kcal/100 g ≈ 54 kcal
- Egg/tofu: 8 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 12 kcal
- Total ≈ 288 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A compact takeout portion of about 200 g and roughly 290 kcal fits what is visible.
